intro: All the commands at a glance: tú, usted, nosotros, vosotros and ustedes, with negatives and pronouns.
p.no me lo digas.consejo: Negative command: «no» + subjunctive, and the pronouns go before the verb: «no me lo digas».
p.ten.consejo: It is an irregular and very short command: «ten cuidado», «ten paciencia».
p.pon.consejo: Short and irregular. You use it to put something somewhere: «pon la mesa».
p.haz.consejo: The z sounds «th». It is used in phrases like «haz tu tarea». It is not «hace».
p.sal.consejo: «Sal de aquí» is very firm. The opposite, negative: «no salgas».
p.di.consejo: «Di» without an accent is the command; «dí» does not exist. With pronouns: «dímelo».
p.ve.consejo: It looks like «ve» of «ver», but here it is «ir»: «ve a casa».
p.ven.consejo: It is the shortest command of «venir»: «ven aquí». Negative: «no vengas».
p.sé.consejo: It has an accent to tell it apart from «se». «Sé amable» is the command of «ser».
p.no te preocupes.consejo: «Preocuparse» is pronominal: the pronoun goes before the verb in the negative.
p.ten cuidado.consejo: It is used to warn of a danger: «ten cuidado con el escalón». The d sounds soft.
p.pasad.consejo: It is formed by dropping the -r of the infinitive and adding -d: «pasar» → «pasad».
p.noticia.consejo: «Una noticia» is one piece of information; «las noticias» are those on TV. The c sounds th.
p.venga.consejo: In conversation it serves to encourage: «¡venga!, vamos». It is also an «usted» command.
b1.texto:
**Tú, affirmative**: the same as «él» of the present: **habla**, **come**, **escribe**. Eight forms are irregular: **di, haz, ve, pon, sal, sé, ten, ven**.

**Vosotros, affirmative**: the -r of the infinitive is changed to -d: **hablad**, **comed**, **venid**.

**Usted, ustedes and nosotros**: the subjunctive is used: **hable**, **hablen**, **hablemos**.

**Negative**: always **no + subjunctive**: **no hables**, **no hable**, **no hablemos**, **no habléis**, **no hablen**.

**Pronouns**: after the verb in the affirmative (**dímelo**) and before it in the negative (**no me lo digas**).
b2.f6.texto: Be careful there and be happy.
b4.texto:
Summary of the five persons:

- **tú**: habla · di · ven → no hables · no digas · no vengas.
- **usted**: hable · diga · venga → no hable · no diga · no venga.
- **nosotros**: hablemos · digamos · vengamos → no hablemos · no digamos · no vengamos.
- **vosotros**: hablad · decid · venid → no habléis · no digáis · no vengáis.
- **ustedes**: hablen · digan · vengan → no hablen · no digan · no vengan.

The pronoun rule never fails: **after** the verb if you state (dímelo, siéntese) and **before** it if you negate (no me lo digas, no se siente). When an extra syllable appears with the pronouns, an accent is written to keep the stress.

For «vamos a» + infinitive you usually just say **vamos**.
b4.e1.texto: Don't put your feet on the chair.
b5.f0.texto: The platform smells of cold iron and freshly made coffee.
b5.f1.texto: A blue suitcase waits next to the bench with its wheels wet.
b5.f2.texto: Lucía hugs her sister and strokes her brown hair.
b5.f3.texto: The station clock marks eight with a thin hand.
b5.f4.texto: A metallic voice announces the departure of the train with slow words.
b5.f5.texto: Her sister gets on the carriage with shining eyes.
b5.f6.texto: The window fills with fingers that say goodbye.
b5.f7.texto: The train pulls away slowly and disappears among the trees of the horizon.
b5.f8.texto: Lucía stays still with her hand raised in the air.
b5.f9.texto: A warm wind shakes her clothes and dries a tear.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! The negative command uses «no» + subjunctive.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Dices» is indicative; the negative command asks for the subjunctive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Di» is the affirmative command, not the negative one.
b6.pregunta: It is a negative command for «tú». What is missing?
b7.o0: Antes del verbo: no me lo digas.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes! In the negative they go after «no» and before the verb.
b7.o1: Al final del verbo: no digasmelo.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Attached to the verb they only go in the affirmative: «dímelo».
b7.o2: Antes de «no»: me lo no digas.
b7.pregunta: Where do the pronouns go in a negative command?
b8.o1.refuerzo: «Tengas» is subjunctive: it only works in the negative.
b8.o2.refuerzo: That's it! «Ten» is the affirmative command of «tener».
b8.pregunta: A warning to a friend with «tú». What is missing?
b9.frase: No se lo digas a nadie todavía
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Hace» is the present of «él»; the command is irregular.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Yes! «Haz» is one of the eight irregular commands.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Hagas» is for the negative command: «no hagas».
b10.pregunta: What is the affirmative command of «hacer» for tú?
b12.pregunta: You speak to several friends with «vosotros». What is missing?
p.digas.consejo: From «decir». Its subjunctive keeps the «g» of «digo»: «digas».
p.celebrarlo.consejo: From «celebrar», with «lo» at the end meaning «it». The «c» before «e» sounds like «th».
p.pongas.consejo: From «poner». It keeps the «g» of «pongo» in the subjunctive.
p.dímelo.consejo: «Di» plus «me» and «lo». The accent shows the stress stays on «DI».
p.aguja.consejo: The thin pointer of a clock. It is feminine: «la aguja».
p.delgada.consejo: It agrees with «aguja», which is feminine, so it ends in -a.
p.anuncia.consejo: From «anunciar», to announce. The «ci» sounds like «thya».
p.horizonte.consejo: The line where the sky seems to meet the land. The «h» is silent.
p.lágrima.consejo: The drop that falls from the eye when you cry. It is feminine.
p.verbo.consejo: A word for actions, like «hablar». The «v» sounds like «b».
